channels.label: EOG_dx
channels.reason: Right EOG ('dx', transducer EOG-Right-A1) referenced to A1 is the right outer canthus channel.

channels.label: Fp2_F4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain Fp2-F4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F4_C4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain F4-C4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_P4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain C4-P4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: P4_O2
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain P4-O2 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to the contralateral mastoid/ear A1 matches C4_M1, with a neuro trace.

channels.label: milo
channels.reason: Italian 'milo' (mylohyoid) with submental chin EMG transducer is the chin EMG.

channels.label: EOG_sin
channels.reason: Left EOG ('sin', transducer EOG-Left-A2) referenced to A2 is the left outer canthus channel.

channels.label: tib_dx
channels.reason: Right tibialis EMG ('tib dx', EMG.Tibialis-Leg.Right) is the right leg channel.

channels.label: tib_sin
channels.reason: Left tibialis EMG ('tib sin', EMG.Tibialis-Leg.Left) with EMG-like trace is the left leg channel.

channels.label: cannula
channels.reason: Nasal cannula pressure in mBar with a respiratory trace is nasal pressure.

channels.label: toracico
channels.reason: Italian 'toracico' with piezo thorax movement transducer is thoracic effort, though the trace type was not classified.

channels.label: ekg
channels.reason: EKG channel in mV with an ECG-like trace.

channels.label: deltoide
channels.reason: Deltoid arm EMG has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: Heart_Rate_Varia
channels.reason: Heart rate variability in bpm/s is a derived measure, not heart rate.

channels.label: Flattening
channels.reason: Derived flow-flattening index has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: Flow
channels.reason: Respiratory flow signal in mL/s with a respiratory trace is the only airflow channel.
